videos.caption: 🌼 Aquí tienes una receta deliciosa y fácil de tarta de piña sin horno, perfecta para  cuando no quieres encender el horno. --- 🍍 Tarta de Piña sin Horno 🕒 Tiempo total Preparación: 25 minutos Reposo en nevera: 4 horas (mínimo) 🍽️ Rinde para 8 a 10 porciones --- 🧂 Ingredientes Base: 200 g de galletas tipo María o Digestive 100 g de mantequilla derretida Relleno: 1 lata grande de piña en almíbar (aprox. 500 g) 1 sobre de gelatina de piña (o neutra si prefieres menos sabor artificial) 200 ml del jugo (almíbar) de la piña 200 ml de agua caliente 200 ml de nata para montar (crema para batir) o crema de leche 200 g de queso crema (tipo Philadelphia) 3 cucharadas de azúcar (ajusta al gusto) Decoración (opcional): Rodajas de piña y cerezas en almíbar Coco rallado o virutas de chocolate blanco --- 👩‍🍳 Preparación paso a paso 1️⃣ Prepara la base 1. Tritura las galletas hasta que queden como polvo fino. 2. Mézclalas con la mantequilla derretida hasta obtener una masa arenosa. 3. Colócala en el fondo de un molde desmontable (22–24 cm) y presiona bien con una cuchara. 4. Mete el molde al refrigerador mientras preparas el relleno. 2️⃣ Prepara la mezcla de piña 1. Drena las rodajas de piña y guarda 200 ml del almíbar. 2. Disuelve el sobre de gelatina en 200 ml de agua caliente. 3. Añade el almíbar de piña y deja que temple un poco. 3️⃣ Prepara la crema 1. En un bol, bate el queso crema con el azúcar hasta que quede suave. 2. Añade la nata (o crema de leche) y mezcla bien. 3. Agrega la gelatina disuelta (ya templada, no caliente) y mezcla hasta integrar. 4. Incorpora trocitos pequeños de piña a la mezcla. 4️⃣ Monta la tarta 1. Vierte la mezcla sobre la base de galleta. 2. Alisa la superficie y lleva a la nevera por mínimo 4 horas (idealmente toda la noche). 5️⃣ Decora 1. Cuando esté firme, decora con rodajas de piña y cerezas. 2. Si quieres, espolvorea coco rallado o virutas de chocolate blanco. --- 💡 Consejos Puedes usar gelatina neutra y añadir esencia de piña o vainilla si prefieres un sabor más natural. Para una textura más ligera, sustituye el queso crema por yogur griego natural. Si la piña es muy ácida, prueba la mezcla antes de refrigerar y ajusta el azúcar. ---

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

Ingredients • 1 lb ground pork • 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced • 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp chili crisp • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1½ tsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 18–20 dumpling wrappers • 1/4 cup chicken broth • Avocado oil For Topping • Soy sauce • Chili crisp • Green onions • Sesame seeds Instructions 1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined. 2. Creamy Garlic Parmesan Penne with Steak, Broccoli & Bell Peppers 🥩🧄🥦🫑🧀🍝 Tender penne pasta tossed with juicy seared steak, crisp-tender broccoli, and sweet bell peppers in a rich garlic Parmesan cream sauce. This skillet dinner is bold, comforting, and loaded with steakhouse flavor—ready in just 30 minutes! 🥩🧄🧀🍝🔥 📝 Ingredients: 12 oz penne pasta 1.25 lb sirloin or ribeye steak, cut into bite-size pieces Salt & black pepper, to taste 1 tsp garlic powder 2 tbsp olive oil 3 tbsp unsalted butter 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup beef or chicken broth 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 cup broccoli florets, blanched 1 red bell pepper, sliced 1 green bell pepper, sliced 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 🔥 Instructions: 1. Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

Basically fall in a bowl. 🤎 INGREDIENTS 6 cups water ¼ tsp salt 2 cinnamon sticks 2 cups uncooked long-grain white rice, rinsed and drained 4 cups whole milk 1 (12 oz) can evaporated milk 1 (14 oz) can sweetened condensed milk 1 cup pumpkin purée 2 tsp pumpkin pie spice 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ tsp ground cinnamon Pinch of salt FOR SERVING Ground cinnamon or pumpkin pie spice Whipped cream, optional Chopped toasted pecans, optional INSTRUCTIONS Add the water, ¼ tsp salt, and cinnamon sticks to a large pot and bring to a boil. Ingredients: For the steak: 2 pounds steak, such as ribeye, sirloin, or strip steak 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon black pepper 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 3 tablespoons butter 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley For the Parmesan cream sauce: 2 tablespoons butter 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup heavy cream 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning 1/4 teaspoon black pepper Pinch of salt, to taste 1 tablespoon chopped chives or parsley Instructions: Pat the steaks dry with paper towels. Season both sides with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Let them rest at room temperature for 20 minutes. Heat a large cast-iron skillet or heavy pan over medium-hiah heat for 2-3 minutes. Add olive oil and and swirl to coat the pan. Place the steaks in the hot skillet and sear for 3-5 minutes per side, depending on thickness and desired doneness. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter and minced garlic to the pan. Spoon the melted garlic butter over the steaks for 1-2 minutes. Transfer the steaks to a plate and loosely cover with foil. Let them rest for 5-10 minutes while you make the sauce. In the same skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds, stirring constantly. Pour in the heavy cream and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Simmer gently for 3-4 minutes. Stir in Parmesan cheese, Dijon mustard, Italian seasoning, black pepper, and a pinch of salt. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until smooth and slightly thickened. Slice the steak against the grain, then spoon the Parmesan cream sauce over the top. Sprinkle with parsley or chives and serve warm with roasted potatoes, green beans. Cheesy Garlic Butter Shrimp Skewers 🍤🧄🧀 Recipe : These juicy shrimp skewers are covered in garlic butter and melted cheese, just like the video. Ingredients 1½ pounds jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails on 3 tablespoons melted butter 4 garlic cloves, minced 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning ½ teaspoon paprika ½ teaspoon onion powder ½ teaspoon salt ¼ teaspoon black pepper 1 tablespoon lemon juice 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese ¼ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 tablespoons chopped parsley Wooden or metal skewers Instructions If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for at least 20 minutes. Pat the shrimp completely dry. Thread 4–5 shrimp tightly onto each skewer. Mix the melted butter, garlic, olive oil, Italian seasoning, paprika, onion powder, salt, pepper and lemon juice. Brush the garlic-butter mixture generously over both sides of the shrimp. Place the skewers on a lined baking sheet and bake at 425°F for 6 minutes. Remove them from the oven and sprinkle generously with mozzarella and Parmesan. Return to the oven for another 3–5 minutes, until the shrimp are pink and the cheese is melted. Broil for 1–2 minutes to create the golden-brown top shown in the video. Drizzle with the remaining garlic butter and finish with fresh parsley and a squeeze of lemon. Important: Shrimp cook quickly. Remove them as soon as they are opaque and reach 145°F internally so they stay juicy. Serve with garlic bread, pasta, rice or roasted vegetables.  #GarlicButterShrimp #ShrimpSkewers #SeafoodRecipe #EasyDinnerIdeas #FoodTokRecipes
